search.mode.title.en: Switch between plain text and regular expression search
search.mode.title.zh: 切換純文字同正規表達式搜尋

results.slow.en: The search took too long and was stopped. Try a simpler pattern.
results.slow.zh: 搜尋用咗太長時間，已經停止。請試用簡單啲嘅表達式。

results.noindex.en: Search needs the page to be served over http or https.
results.noindex.zh: 搜尋需要經 http 或者 https 開啟呢個頁面。

rx.note.en: Build a pattern here. It searches the same documents, runs with a time limit, and shows what each part means.
rx.note.zh: 喺呢度砌表達式。佢會搜尋同一批文件、有時間限制，並解釋每一部分嘅意思。

rx.sample.placeholder.en: Paste or type text to test the pattern
rx.sample.placeholder.zh: 貼上或者輸入文字嚟測試表達式

rx.empty.en: Type a pattern to see it explained.
rx.empty.zh: 輸入表達式就會見到解釋。

rx.matches.zh: 範例入面有 {n} 個相符。

rx.x.digit.zh: 一個 0 至 9 嘅數字

rx.x.ndigit.en: any character that is not a digit

rx.x.word.zh: 一個字母、數字或者底線

rx.x.nword.en: any character that is not a letter, digit or underscore
rx.x.nword.zh: 唔係字母、數字或者底線嘅字元

rx.x.space.en: a space, tab or line break
rx.x.space.zh: 一個空格、tab 或者換行

rx.x.nspace.en: any character that is not whitespace

rx.x.start.en: the start of the text (or of a line with the m flag)
rx.x.start.zh: 文字嘅開頭（用咗 m 旗標就係每行開頭）

rx.x.end.en: the end of the text (or of a line with the m flag)
rx.x.end.zh: 文字嘅結尾（用咗 m 旗標就係每行結尾）

rx.x.nwordb.en: a place that is not the edge of a word

rx.x.star.en: repeat the previous part 0 or more times
rx.x.star.zh: 上一部分重複 0 次或以上

rx.x.plus.en: repeat the previous part 1 or more times
rx.x.plus.zh: 上一部分重複 1 次或以上

rx.x.quant.en: repeat the previous part the given number of times
rx.x.quant.zh: 上一部分重複指定嘅次數

rx.x.lazy.en: take as few repeats as possible

rx.x.class.zh: 呢個集合入面嘅一個字元

rx.x.nclass.en: one character that is not in this set
rx.x.nclass.zh: 唔喺呢個集合入面嘅一個字元

rx.x.group.en: capture the matched text as a numbered group
rx.x.group.zh: 將相符嘅文字記錄為編號群組

rx.x.named.en: capture the matched text as a named group
rx.x.named.zh: 將相符嘅文字記錄為命名群組

rx.x.ncgroup.zh: 將幾個部分組埋一齊，但唔記錄

rx.x.look.en: only if what follows matches this

rx.x.nlook.en: only if what follows does not match this

rx.x.lookb.en: only if what comes before matches this

rx.x.nlookb.en: only if what comes before does not match this

rx.x.alt.en: either what is on the left or what is on the right
rx.x.alt.zh: 左邊或者右邊其中一個

rx.x.back.en: the same text that the numbered group matched
rx.x.back.zh: 同該編號群組相符嘅同一段文字

rx.x.prop.en: a character with this Unicode property
rx.x.prop.zh: 具備呢個 Unicode 屬性嘅字元

rx.x.escape.en: the character itself, not its special meaning
rx.x.escape.zh: 呢個字元本身，唔使特別意思

settings.motion.hint.en: If your device asks for reduced motion, animation stays off whatever you pick here.
settings.motion.hint.zh: 如果你部裝置要求減少動態效果，無論你喺度揀乜，動畫都會保持關閉。

hero.title.en: Manage your Asus router in plain language.
hero.title.zh: 用淺白嘅方式管理你嘅 Asus 路由器。

hero.lead.en: Readable controls instead of cryptic menus. Every change shows what will change first, a safety timer on the router undoes anything that cuts you off, and one click puts it back.
hero.lead.zh: 唔使再對住難明嘅選單。每次改動前都會先顯示會變啲乜，路由器上面嘅安全計時器會還原令你斷線嘅改動，仲可以一鍵還原。

hero.p1.en: Works with stock ASUS firmware and Asuswrt-Merlin
hero.p1.zh: 支援原廠 ASUS 韌體同 Asuswrt-Merlin

hero.p2.en: Signs in over SSH with a generated key
hero.p2.zh: 用自動產生嘅金鑰經 SSH 登入

hero.p3.en: Try everything on a built-in pretend router
hero.p3.zh: 可以喺內置嘅模擬路由器試晒所有功能

hero.card.guard.en: Timed revert armed on the router
hero.card.guard.zh: 路由器已設定定時還原

tasks.title.en: What do you want to do?

tasks.intro.en: Start from the job, not the menu. Each card opens a short guide.
tasks.intro.zh: 由你想做嘅事開始，唔使理選單。每張卡都會打開一篇簡短指南。

task.install.d.en: Run the setup script. It picks a free port and prints the link.
task.install.d.zh: 執行設定程式。佢會揀一個可用嘅連接埠，並顯示連結。

task.connect.d.en: Use a generated SSH key or the router password, and approve the host key once.
task.connect.d.zh: 用自動產生嘅 SSH 金鑰或者路由器密碼，並一次過核准主機金鑰。

task.wifi.d.en: Rename a network or change its password with a preview and a safety timer.
task.wifi.d.zh: 改網絡名稱或者密碼，有預覽同安全計時器保護。

task.undo.d.en: Open the history and put the previous values back.
task.undo.d.zh: 打開歷史，將之前嘅數值放返落去。

task.family.d.en: Give each person the right role: operator or viewer.
task.family.d.zh: 俾每個人啱嘅角色：操作員或者檢視者。

task.demo.d.en: Explore every screen without touching a real router.
task.demo.d.zh: 唔使掂真路由器都可以逛晒所有畫面。

demo.intro.en: This is how every change works. Press the buttons to see the preview, the safety timer, and what happens when the connection is lost.
demo.intro.zh: 每次改動都係咁運作。按啲掣睇吓預覽、安全計時器，同斷線之後會發生乜事。

demo.banner.zh: 示範而已，唔係你嘅路由器

demo.change.title.zh: 更改 2.4 GHz 網絡名稱

demo.change.desc.en: A network name change drops every device on that band for a moment, so the guard is used.
demo.change.desc.zh: 改網絡名稱會令呢個頻段嘅所有裝置暫時斷線，所以會用保護機制。

demo.guard.idle.en: Not armed yet. The router only starts the timer when you apply.
demo.guard.idle.zh: 仲未啟動。你套用改動之後，路由器先會開始計時。

demo.guard.armed.en: The timer is running on the router. If nothing cancels it, the router restores the old values.
demo.guard.armed.zh: 計時器喺路由器上面運行緊。如果冇人取消，路由器就會還原舊值。

demo.guard.done.en: The app reached the router, so the timer was cancelled.
demo.guard.done.zh: 程式連到路由器，所以計時器已經取消。

demo.guard.fired.en: The timer ran out, so the router restored the old values by itself.
demo.guard.fired.zh: 計時器完咗，路由器自己還原咗舊值。

demo.speed.en: The demonstration counts down faster than the real 90 seconds so you do not have to wait.
demo.speed.zh: 示範嘅倒數比真實嘅 90 秒快，所以你唔使等。

demo.st.preview.en: Check the old and new values, then confirm.
demo.st.preview.zh: 睇清楚舊值同新值，然後確認。

demo.st.armed.en: Applied and guarded. Waiting for the app to reach the router again.
demo.st.armed.zh: 已套用並受保護。等緊程式再次連到路由器。

demo.st.applied.en: Done. The change is applied and the timer is cancelled.
demo.st.applied.zh: 完成。改動已套用，計時器已取消。

demo.st.reverted.en: Reverted. The router put the old values back by itself.
demo.st.reverted.zh: 已還原。路由器自己將舊值放返落去。

demo.st.undone.en: Undone. The previous network name is back.
demo.st.undone.zh: 已還原。之前嘅網絡名稱返嚟咗。

demo.btn.reach.en: The app reaches the router again

demo.log.preview.en: Preview shown. Nothing has changed yet.
demo.log.preview.zh: 已顯示預覽。暫時冇改動。

demo.log.confirm.en: You confirmed. The previous values were saved.
demo.log.confirm.zh: 你已確認。之前嘅數值已儲存。

demo.log.arm.en: Timed revert armed on the router: 90 seconds.
demo.log.arm.zh: 路由器已設定定時還原：90 秒。

demo.log.reach.en: The app reached the router again. The timed revert was cancelled.
demo.log.reach.zh: 程式再次連到路由器，定時還原已取消。

demo.log.lost.en: The connection was lost. The app cannot reach the router.
demo.log.lost.zh: 斷咗線，程式連唔到路由器。

demo.log.revert.en: The timer ran out. The router restored the previous values.
demo.log.revert.zh: 計時完咗，路由器已還原之前嘅數值。

demo.log.undo.en: Undo: the previous values were put back.
demo.log.undo.zh: 還原：之前嘅數值已放返落去。

guard.intro.en: Some changes can cut the link between the app and the router. Click each step to see what happens and why the timer lives on the router, not in the app.
guard.intro.zh: 有啲改動可能會切斷程式同路由器之間嘅連線。逐個步驟撳落去睇會發生乜事，同埋點解計時器喺路由器而唔係喺程式入面。

guard.d1.en: You see the old and the new value side by side, in plain words. Nothing has changed yet, and you can walk away.
guard.d1.zh: 舊值同新值會用淺白文字並排顯示。暫時冇任何改動，你可以隨時放棄。

guard.d2.en: Before anything is written, the app saves the current values. This is what makes one-click undo possible later.
guard.d2.zh: 喺寫入任何嘢之前，程式會先儲存現有數值。呢個就係之後可以一鍵還原嘅原因。

guard.d3.en: For changes that can affect the network, the router is told: put these old values back in 90 seconds unless you hear from me. The timer runs on the router itself, so it still fires if the app, your device or your connection disappears.
guard.d3.zh: 對於可能影響網絡嘅改動，會先通知路由器：90 秒之後將呢啲舊值放返落去，除非收到我嘅取消通知。計時器喺路由器本身運行，所以就算程式、你部裝置或者你嘅連線消失，佢都照樣會觸發。

guard.d4.en: Now the change is written to the router. If it affects the connection you are using, you may lose contact here.
guard.d4.zh: 而家先將改動寫入路由器。如果改動影響你而家用緊嘅連線，你可能喺呢一步失去聯絡。

guard.d5.en: The app tries to reach the router again using the new settings, for example by reconnecting over SSH. Two things can happen next.
guard.d5.zh: 程式會用新設定再次嘗試連接路由器，例如重新經 SSH 連線。之後有兩種可能。

guard.d6a.en: The app reached the router. It cancels the timer, confirms the new values were applied, and records the change in history.
guard.d6a.zh: 程式連到路由器。佢會取消計時器，確認新數值已套用，並將改動記入歷史。

guard.d6b.en: Nobody cancelled the timer. After 90 seconds the router puts the saved values back by itself, and your connection comes back. You can then look at the history to see what happened.
guard.d6b.zh: 冇人取消計時器。90 秒後，路由器會自己將儲存咗嘅數值放返落去，你嘅連線就會恢復。之後可以喺歷史度睇到發生過乜事。

features.intro.en: Each area has its own guide. The badge tells you honestly whether it is ready or still being built.
features.intro.zh: 每個範圍都有自己嘅指南。標籤會老實話你知係已經完成定係仲喺開發中。

install.intro.en: Pick the route that suits you. All of them keep your settings and history in a data volume, so updating never wipes them.
install.intro.zh: 揀一條適合你嘅途徑。全部都會將設定同歷史保存喺資料卷，所以更新唔會洗走佢哋。

install.one.d.en: Clones the project and runs the interactive setup. It asks only for what it cannot choose, picks a free port, and prints the link when the app is healthy.
install.one.d.zh: 下載專案並執行互動式設定。佢只會問你揀唔到嘅嘢，自動揀可用連接埠，應用程式健康運作之後會顯示連結。

install.one.note.en: The router password is never asked here. You type it only in the app's own setup screen.
install.one.note.zh: 呢度唔會問路由器密碼。你只會喺程式自己嘅設定畫面輸入。

install.host.d.en: One click starts the app with Docker on this computer, or on another Docker host over SSH.
install.host.d.zh: 一鍵就用 Docker 喺呢部電腦啟動程式，或者經 SSH 喺另一部 Docker 主機啟動。

install.mode.logs.en: start, then watch status and logs
install.mode.logs.zh: 啟動，然後睇狀態同記錄

install.mode.stop.zh: 停止（設定同歷史會保留）

install.mode.remote.en: run on a Docker host over SSH
install.mode.remote.zh: 經 SSH 喺 Docker 主機執行

install.compose.d.en: Use the tracked compose.yaml directly if you already run Docker.
install.compose.d.zh: 如果你已經用緊 Docker，可以直接用專案入面嘅 compose.yaml。

install.secret.en: The router password, if you choose to use one, is typed only in the app and stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The default is an app-generated SSH key, so no password is needed.
install.secret.zh: 如果你揀用路由器密碼，只會喺程式入面輸入，並以 AES-256-GCM 加密儲存。預設係程式自動產生嘅 SSH 金鑰，所以唔使密碼。

download.intro.en: This section lists a release only when it is a normal, published release with files attached. It is read from the project's release data when the site is built.
download.intro.zh: 只有正式發佈並附有檔案嘅版本先會列喺度。資料喺建置網站時由專案嘅發佈資料讀取。

download.empty.title.en: There is no verified release to download yet
download.empty.title.zh: 暫時未有已核實嘅版本可以下載

download.none.en: No release has been published yet. Nothing is shown here until one is, so there is no download button to break.
download.none.zh: 仲未有發佈任何版本。有版本之前呢度唔會顯示任何嘢，所以唔會有壞咗嘅下載掣。

download.notchecked.en: This copy of the site was built without access to the release data, so no release is shown. The published site is rebuilt with it.
download.notchecked.zh: 呢個版本嘅網站建置時冇讀取發佈資料，所以冇顯示任何版本。正式網站重建時會包括。

download.unavailable.en: The release data could not be read at build time, so no release is shown. Nothing is guessed.
download.unavailable.zh: 建置時讀取唔到發佈資料，所以冇顯示任何版本。唔會估計。

download.incomplete.en: The latest release has no attached files or is not a normal release, so it is not offered as a download.
download.incomplete.zh: 最新版本冇附加檔案或者唔係正式版本，所以唔會提供下載。

download.alt.en: You can run the app today from the Docker image. See the install section.
download.alt.zh: 你而家已經可以用 Docker 映像執行程式。請睇安裝部分。

download.nohash.en: Checksum not published for this file
download.nohash.zh: 呢個檔案冇公佈校驗碼

download.how.en: After downloading, compare the SHA-256 shown here with the one your computer calculates.
download.how.zh: 下載之後，將呢度顯示嘅 SHA-256 同你電腦計出嚟嘅對一對。

shots.intro.en: Only captures from a real build are shown here, each listed with its state and commit.
shots.intro.zh: 呢度只會顯示由真實建置擷取嘅畫面，並註明狀態同提交編號。

shots.empty.en: Screenshots will appear after the first verified capture.
shots.empty.zh: 第一次經核實嘅擷取之後，截圖就會顯示喺度。

shots.placeholder.en: Screenshot will appear after the first verified capture
shots.placeholder.zh: 第一次經核實嘅擷取之後，截圖就會顯示

articles.lead.en: Task-led guides grouped by what you are trying to do. Every guide says whether the feature is ready or still in progress.
articles.lead.zh: 按你想做嘅事分類嘅指南。每篇指南都會講明功能係已完成定係仲喺開發中。

articles.wiki.en: Looking for short answers and reference notes? See the
articles.wiki.zh: 想搵簡短答案同參考筆記？請睇

category.empty.en: Guides for this section are on their way.
category.empty.zh: 呢個部分嘅指南仲喺撰寫中。

wiki.lead.en: Short answers, definitions and reference notes. Everything here is also available offline in the phone PDF edition.
wiki.lead.zh: 簡短答案、詞彙同參考筆記。呢度所有內容都可以喺手機 PDF 版離線閱讀。

article.nozh.en: This page has no Cantonese version yet, so the English text is shown.
article.nozh.zh: 呢一頁暫時未有廣東話版本，所以顯示英文內容。

article.inprogress.en: This feature is still being built. The guide describes the planned behaviour and says what is missing.
article.inprogress.zh: 呢個功能仲喺開發中。指南講述計劃中嘅運作方式，並說明欠咗啲乜。

footer.tagline.en: A self-hosted web app that manages an Asus router over SSH, with previews, a connection-loss guard and undo.
footer.tagline.zh: 自行架設嘅網頁程式，經 SSH 管理 Asus 路由器，有預覽、斷線保護同還原。

notfound.text.en: The page may have moved. Try the search box above, or go back to the home page.
notfound.text.zh: 呢一頁可能搬咗。可以用上面嘅搜尋框，或者返去首頁。
